notes: Ant body treated as spine: thorax (root, central) -> head (leaf, via short neck, droops slightly down) and thorax -> petiole -> gaster (gaster is trunk/abdomen terminus, NOT a leaf since it's not a discrete external appendage like a tail). Three attachment points along thorax (thorax_front, thorax itself as mid, thorax_hind) inferred from leg-pair spacing seen in ZY/XZ panels, each anchoring a bilateral leg pair. Each leg simplified to a 2-segment chain (hip->knee->foot) inferred from the visible knee bend in the XY/ZY panels; more detailed insect leg segmentation (coxa/trochanter/femur/tibia/tarsus) was collapsed for clarity. Antennae and mandibles are excluded as leaves per sub-flap-detail rule. Left/right assigned by z<12 = R, z>12 = L (arbitrary but consistent mesh convention, noted since animal-relative handedness isn't recoverable from orthographic views alone). All leg directions verified to have negative dy (downward) at each segment per the flip-sign check.
